name: Free
features: Up to 10 questions per survey
Up to 100 responses per survey
Two live surveys at any time
Single-choice, multi-choice, rating and short-text questions
Public survey URL with F.M.I.E branding
Standard response analytics in the dashboard
Anonymous response option
Editorial moderation before publication
exclusions: No Likert or long-text question types

name: Premium
features: Unlimited questions per survey
Up to 5,000 responses per survey
Unlimited live surveys
All question types including Likert scales and long text
Conditional logic and branching with a visual logic map
CSV and spreadsheet export with a documented methodology note
Completion rate, drop-off point and segment filters
Custom branding, logo and colour treatment
Extended survey duration up to twelve months
Priority editorial moderation within two working days
Discount codes and payment receipts
exclusions: No multi-seat team management beyond three seats
No consolidated billing history or purchase orders

name: Corporate
features: Everything in Premium
Unlimited responses and unlimited surveys
Fifteen named seats with role-based access
Consolidated billing history, invoices and purchase orders
Branded survey environments per business unit
Cross-survey reporting and trend comparison
Named research consultant and quarterly methodology review
Documented sampling and weighting methodology where commissioned
Data retention and deletion controls aligned to a written schedule
Optional audience recruitment, quoted separately and subject to operational capacity
exclusions: Audience recruitment is quoted separately and is never guaranteed
Statistical representativeness requires a documented probability sample and is not conferred by the plan
